---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest a new platform, capability, or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of the problem you're facing. e.g. "I can't download
slideshows from platform X because…"

## Proposed solution

What you'd like FED-GRAM to do. Be as specific as possible.

## Is this a new platform?

If yes:

- **Platform name:**
- **Example public URL:**
- **What kind of media?** (images / video / audio / carousel / album)
- **Is the content public without login?** (yes / no / sometimes)

We may ask you to help test the URL; new engine PRs are very welcome (see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)).

## Alternatives you've considered

Any other ways you thought about solving this, and why they're not ideal.

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, links, or anything else that helps explain the request.
